status: implemented but unverified on GitHub; six local real-Git/stand-in tests and full lint pass
mechanism: A bounded exact-base/head Git diff selects source/fuzz/native jobs when runtime inputs change. The independent scoped security/source/binary/history/secret job remains unchanged and runs for every event. Manual dispatch selects all; unknown event/base/diff/names conservatively select all. A mismatched candidate checkout fails selection rather than claiming a pass.
classification: Only evidence, Markdown under docs, README/STATUS and seven named documentation-data ledgers avoid duplicate runtime campaigns. Known JVM/upgrade pins and recipient certificate select full. Unknown/new configuration or data files select full. Renames include both old/new paths with external diff/text conversion disabled.
bounds: 2MiB event data,30second/8MiB diff,100000normalized paths; exact40hex base/head. Public selection metadata contains fixed reason/count/hash, no raw filenames or event payload.
workflow: One five-minute selection job gates only the three logical source/fuzz/native jobs; all original matrices, commands, budgets, permissions and concurrency values remain semantically identical. Security has no new dependency/condition. Native full union becomes29jobs/sevenworkflows; actual logical/matrix skip expansion must be enumerated from real metadata.

Cases cover docs-only, runtime pins/instructions/unknown files, runtime-to-doc rename, PR exact base, manual/unknown/missing-base full selection, candidate mismatch and bounded/malformed diff fallback.
Workflow YAML semantic comparison removes only the new selection job/needs/if fields and exactly equals the prior workflow.
